fusions.name: Heavy War-Draw
fusions.desc: Looses a heavy arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 32 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Make Room
fusions.desc: Swings the stave in a full circle that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you and knocks them back 3 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Turned at Bay
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Sore-Headed
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
